start.text: Everyone stands in the middle of the bandstand. Stand at the edge, where the railing curves - see? Now the bandstand is the subject, not you. (click) Okay. Bamboo. This way.

bamboo.text: Four o'clock light. Told you. Don't move - (click) - that one's for me. People pay for this and I get it for the price of a cycle. Library steps next, then I let you go.

library.text: Red building, white pillars, a hundred and ten years of people meaning to read. Your turn - stand on the third step. No, smile less. (click) Sent. That's your new wallpaper, by the way.
